run_SPMDWorker: run a Ray remote SPMDWorker actor that initializes distributed setup and executes a Runner payload
create_SPMDController: create an SPMDController that spawns SPMDWorker actors across placement groups on a Ray cluster
run_SPMDController: run the SPMDController to launch all SPMDWorker actors and wait for completion via ray.get
run_ray_entrypoint: run the ray_entrypoint function to instantiate and execute a Runner from a Hydra config
run_ray_on_slurm_launch: run ray_on_slurm_launch to start a Ray cluster on Slurm and execute a payload across nodes
